text_block_list.text: The "Summer Training Camp" begins today, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear? Apparently
Vodka is taking part in this training camp too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aargh... What a shame, and here I thought it was our chance to pull ahead.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Look at it the other way, though: conditions are 50-50.
That means there's no handicap whatsoever."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
At the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I'll beat her with
everything I've got and take first place—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to build up my strength this summer!
All so I can become the number one Umamusume!!
